# zeroword_workspace (Data Source)

Reads a Workspace. Workspaces are created in the Dashboard; an API key cannot create them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zeroword_workspace" "this" {
  id = "wsp_4gfdophhaylex4m2cscbhc2nwui4anlf"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Workspace ID (`wsp_...`).

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) URL slug.
- `status` (String) Workspace status.
